params.body:
The "Dependency audits" job fails on every pull request since advisories published from 4 November, including on docs-only changes such as #284. The last green run on `main` was on a4310c79 (28 October).

`composer audit --locked` reported 9 advisories in six Symfony packages. This moves each to the patched release in the same minor line:

| package | from | to |
|---|---|---|
| symfony/filesystem | 8.1.2 | 8.1.11 |
| symfony/http-foundation | 8.1.9 | 8.1.11 |
| symfony/http-kernel | 8.1.4 | 8.1.11 |
| symfony/mime | 8.1.4 | 8.1.10 |
| symfony/routing | 8.1.2 | 8.1.11 |
| symfony/yaml | 8.1.9 | 8.1.11 |

With that fixed, `npm audit --audit-level=high` in the same job still failed, on follow-redirects 1.16.1 (high, transitive). It moves to 1.16.3, and nothing else changes in `package-lock.json`.

Done with `composer update <the six> --minimal-changes --with-dependencies` and `npm update follow-redirects --package-lock-only`. Only the lockfiles change, with no constraint edits. Both audit commands now exit 0 locally. The test suite is left to CI.

Not in this change: four moderate npm advisories in the eslint 10 tree (eslint, @eslint/js, @eslint/config-array, minimatch). npm's only fix is a downgrade to eslint 9, and the job's `--audit-level=high` does not fail on them.
params.title: Patch the packages that fail the dependency audit
